d: Are you looking to make a difference in security cooperation?

Sincerus is looking for former U.S. military experienced professional and a highly skilled subject matter expert to join our Training Team in support of partner nation Patriot System Firing Units. This 14H role focuses on preparing the unit to successfully operate and maintain the Patriot system's enhanced early warning systems.
q: Preferred to have at least five years of experience as a MOS 14H in a U.S. Army Patriot Battalion.
MUST possess an Active Department of Defense SECRET Security Clearance
Served as an Operator/Maintainer (14H 40/30) in a U.S. Patriot Battery and must have certified as a crew member of a Patriot EW System
Be a subject matter expert in evaluating and communicating data about incoming enemy aerial and missile attacks and aerial surveillance.

Capable of maintaining computer data links and networks that provide early detection and tracking of possible air threats from the earth's surface to space, giving units situational awareness and data needed to enable threat engagement and destruction and sustain air space superiority.
Doctor's certificate of health and up-to-date immunizations for designated countries
Has experience as an instructor/ trainer
x: Location: Worldwide (Middle East, Eastern Europe, and the Pacific Region)
Duration: 12 months with follow on opportunity
